subject: 수능특강Light 영어
title: 브랜드화의 역할: 인지도를 통한 소비자의 위험 감소
fullPassage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
